candidate.rule: Declare and commit the final candidate before freezing assets or selecting fresh IDs. Null identities prohibit a freeze.

cohort.selection: Sort SHA256(prefix + ID), then ID; exclude the complete distinct union of all four historical cohorts before selection.
cohort.source: The exact original HotpotQA validation Parquet bytes in benchmarks/hotpot_manifest.json. Selection decodes IDs before selected rows; no human inspection or outcome filtering.

native.boundary: Complete in-process native Python recall, including native context assembly and exact token budgeting. Fresh ingestion and initialization recorded separately.

components.projections: First response only; common whole-block packing at both registered tokenizers and all three token caps, offline and outside search latency.
components.ai_memory_reads: On repetition zero read every mapped native top-five page completely; retain None/unmapped slots without replacement. Record actual read count, payload, latency and per-query search-plus-all-reads separately; at most 1280 page reads.

independent_validation.cache_policy: Native and component Book query-result caches disabled. Both sources' bounded derived token-count memo remains enabled and naturally warms across fixed native configurations. Include every first call; no additional warmup, selective clearing or omitted sample.

dependencies.model_policy: Only ai-memory's locked local embedding model is prepared and verified. Q2 is excluded; no Book semantic model or generative model is used. Existing lock byte counts and SHA256 values remain mandatory.

freeze_order: Commit this plan and all new evaluator/controller/workflow/test code.
Commit the declared exact v0.3.3 baseline and final candidate source hashes.
Verify all evaluator/reused-helper bytes, Python/Node dependencies, locked upstream assets and local model files without reading question content or scoring.
Publish the asset receipt, then the complete source/evaluator/dependency/model binding to Git before fresh ID selection.
Read the exact Parquet ID column, exclude all 896 historical IDs, select the deterministic fresh 256, and publish the manifest before scoring.
Claim the binding once, then publish each stage intent before execution and all raw/summary/ledger bytes after completion or failure before progressing.

acceptance.integrity: Every registered call, complete ledger event, source/scope/budget invariant and all 42 cells must verify. All 1536 native and 768 component baseline/candidate complete non-timing payload pairs must match; exclude only latency_ms.
acceptance.competitor_outcome: Report all measured wins, ties and losses. No minimum competitor win is imposed after observing outcomes. This comparison never substitutes for the separately registered 10/15/10 balanced performance gates.
acceptance.no_replay: One first-attempt hosted execution per immutable binding. No scoring before committed freeze/selection, replay into alternate directories, resumed failed stage, replaced adverse sample, retuning on these IDs or implicit workflow retry. Preserve incomplete attempts; any recovery requires a new explicit registration.

reporting: All native and component quality cells, per-query gains/losses, exact source/upstream identities and full raw source-free records.
Search, first-search-plus-all-reads, offline packing, setup/ingestion, RSS and storage as distinct boundaries. Preserve all adverse cells and errors.
Sequential component timings are descriptive; Python assembly, SQLite/Bun, HTTP/MCP and Node kernel boundaries differ and do not establish whole-product speed ratios.

This is a new selection from the same public HotpotQA source, not a new domain. All selected questions are answerable; unsupported/no-answer behavior and hallucination rates remain unmeasured. Empty retrievals remain in the results.
After first scoring these IDs are regression data. Q2, generated-answer quality, private-conversation transfer and universal superiority are outside this comparison.
